bio.zh: Troilo（暱稱 Pichuco）是探戈史上最受愛戴的人物之一：班多鈕琴大師，也極擅長挑選歌手與詞人。年輕的 Piazzolla 曾在他樂團裡吹班多鈕琴並幫忙編曲。
bio.en: Troilo (nicknamed Pichuco) is among the most beloved figures in tango: a bandoneón master and a gifted curator of singers and poets. A young Piazzolla played bandoneón in his orchestra and contributed arrangements.

sound_description.zh: 節奏還在，但像被棉布包起來——不刺、不趕。旋律線更有呼吸感，和聲比節奏系更有色彩。D'Arienzo 說「走」，Troilo 說「聽我講故事」。
sound_description.en: The beat remains, but wrapped in cotton—never harsh or rushed. Melodic lines breathe; harmony is more colourful than the hard-rhythmic orquestas. Where D'Arienzo says 'move', Troilo says 'listen to a story'.
